0022600027.text: The 76ers (8-1, first in the East and first in the Atlantic) are on a five-game winning streak and have gone 4-0 on the road, while the Cavaliers (4-4, sixth in the East) have lost their last two. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), and Adem Bona is day-to-day with a head injury and a game-time decision. Cleveland is missing Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain), and Jarrett Allen (knee), Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness) and Tyrese Proctor (ankle) are all day-to-day game-time decisions. Philadelphia leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after its 114-106 win in Philadelphia on October 22, and it lost all four meetings in the 2025-26 season.
